answer: The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Before the stamp comes £9 in fees and a 3-day delay before the stamp dries, and a name that cannot pay it never gets stamped. No Meadowbound vineyard man pasture patent, no seat: the rule is plain, and a patent men file after vineyard reviews is why it holds. atlas is written on the receipt. saffron stays on the record. Every vine is counted once.
